name: abuse
description: Persistent, pseudonymous rate limits, failure backoff and challenge escalation for extensions

maxKeys.description: Hard bound on stored counters across every consumer (default 100000). Each claimed scope gets an equal share, so one consumer cannot fill the table; a full table answers 503 rather than forgetting counts.

authoring.description: Persistent, pseudonymous counters other extensions call: request budgets, failure backoff and challenge escalation. It has no routes and no route policy; use policies.throttle for a declarative per-route budget.

surfaces.name: maxKeys
surfaces.description: Hard bound on stored counters (1000..1000000, default 100000); a full table answers 503.

agent.description: Local, revision-pinned references for agents configuring the abuse extension or consuming its exports.

references.name: abuse extension guide
references.description: Configuration and the budget, backoff and challenge exports other extensions call; ends with the generated field reference for every configuration key.

references.name: abuse security model
references.description: Pseudonymous keys, bounded storage, fail-closed behavior and what the counters do not protect.
